review:
A lot packed into the John Hunter formula. Six money symbols start three respins with sticky money symbols that reset the counter, and filling all 15 spots adds 2,000x.

Three scatters or super scatters give free spins at a random Bronze, Silver, Gold or Super level – you can gamble for a higher level first – and every fourth scatter in the bonus upgrades the level and adds two spins. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
